records.name: Minimal terminating nonconfluent fork
records.minimality: Three states are minimal for a terminating unlabelled relation with two distinct reachable normal forms.
nonclaims: The fixture is an abstract rewriting counterexample, not a physical process.

records.name: Minimal confluent nonterminating loop
records.minimality: One state is minimal when self-loops are allowed.
nonclaims: Irreflexive rewrite systems would require a two-state cycle instead.

records.name: Unique reachable normal form with a nonterminating branch
records.minimality: Two states are minimal for nontermination together with a unique reachable normal form when self-loops are allowed.
nonclaims: Finite reflexive-transitive reachability alone cannot express universal liveness over infinite paths.
